evidence.name: Screen field: Link a choice to this value
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Link a choice to this value" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Link a choice to this value
sections.description: Connect this option to the on-screen choice (the list or grid row) that should set it, so when a visitor picks that row the variable stores this value. Each visible choice should map to one option so answers record correctly, and several options can point to the same row if needed. If a choice has no option mapped to it, the editor flags it as unmapped, so fix that before publishing or it won't record an answer.
